proof_summary: Writing \(F_n=\lfloor e^{H_n}\rfloor\), the proof establishes \(1<e^{H_{n+1}}-e^{H_n}<2\) using harmonic–log and exponential bounds (with the small cases handled directly), so \(F_{n+1}-F_n\in\{1,2\}\) and hence the rank gaps are 2 or 3. Telescoping expresses the two counts in terms of \(F_{N+1}\); since \(F_N/N\to e^\gamma\), their ratio tends to \((e^\gamma-1)/(2-e^\gamma)\), and rational exponential estimates at index 1024 give \(16/9<e^\gamma<41/23\), placing this limit strictly between 3.5 and 3.6.
